plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Psychology - Human Services Emphasis (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Psychology Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Human Services Emphasis (Campus)', last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026 (the workbook Index lists Online as N/A for this program). Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints a single combined total, 'Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120', which the map matches exactly (15/16/14/15/15/15/15/15), and the map's own note states students electing the Bachelor of Arts will take 16 credits of one foreign language, not included in the map; the BS degree requirement (12 credits of math or science) may be met in part through General Education per the catalog. The major slots exercised in the map sum to exactly the catalog's Psychology - Human Services Curriculum of 55 credits (Foundation 10, Methods 8, Developmental 3, Abnormal 3, Bio-Psychology 3, Cognitive 3, Social/Personality 3, Diversity 3, Capstone 3, Human Services Emphasis 16), and each choice slot carries the catalog's listed options for that block. The Methods slots exercise the catalog's lecture/lab pairings (PSY 3400/3405, PSY 3410/3415, PSY 3430/3435); the catalog states a given pairing may not be broken up or taken separately. PSY 4891 is catalogued at 3-12 credits and is placed by the map at 3; the Diversity slot's PSY 4999 option is catalogued at 1-6 credits (Study Abroad; must be at least 3 credit hours per the catalog). Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates: PSY 2000 (map: 'Introduction to Human Services'), PSY 2010 (map: 'Psychology as a Science & Profession'), PSY 3800 (map: 'Professional Roles & Ethics Practicum'). All major courses must be passed with a C- or better per the catalog.
